name: sverify-vscode
description: sverify's checks in the editor: diagnostics, quick fixes from inference, hovers with what Lean proved, and contract completion.

sverify.pythonPath.description: The Python interpreter with sverify installed. Empty: the workspace's .venv, then python3. ${workspaceFolder} is replaced.

sverify.checkOnSave.description: Check a Python file that imports sverify when it is saved (and when it is opened).

sverify.counterexamples.description: Inputs tried per unproved postcondition to find a counterexample, for the file's own sv.verify calls too (SVERIFY_COUNTEREXAMPLES). null: sverify's default (200). 0 is fastest.

sverify.previewFixes.description: Show a quick fix's edit in the refactor preview before applying it.
